TET2 x ISR translatomic transfer: research report (smoke)

SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION. Every number, figure and gene ID (SYN...) below comes from simulated data with planted effects. It shows that the software works and what the design can and cannot identify. It says nothing about real TET2 biology.

Regenerate with make smoke-test. Methods: docs/methods.md. Limits: docs/assumptions_and_limits.md. Inputs and checksums: provenance.json in the run directory.

1. Datasets and evidence map

Full fields, including how each was verified: data/dataset_manifest.tsv.

GSE232384 mouse LT-HSC, ST-HSC, CMP, GMP, MEP, CLP (200 sorted cells each) LT-HSC: 4 KO vs 3 WT animals; other populations 4 vs 3-4 SMART-seq bulk RNA-seq M0/M1/M2: target LT-HSC 200-cell libraries are noisy; Tet2 transcript not reduced in KO (allele not verifiable from expression); cGAS-STING focus
GSE287524 human CD34+ HSPC (day 4 long-term culture) and CD14+ monocytes (day 14) 3 vs 3 per cell type and treatment bulk RNA-seq (RSEM) M0/M1/M2: target CD34_HSPC untreated cultured CD34+ cells, not HSC; edited pool is a mixture; WT/mutant share culture (paired design not exploited); TET2 mRNA unchanged
GSE212534 mouse sorted donor (GFP+) HSC and MPP3, 13 months post-transplant 2 vs 2 libraries per population (whether libraries are single recipients or pools is not stated) 10x scRNA-seq M0/M1/M2: target HSC aged, transplanted, clonally selected cells; 2 replicates; cells never used as replicates
GSE183675 mouse LSK (young and old) 2 vs 2 mice per age SMART-seq RNA-seq (+WGBS, CMS-IP, ChIP, scATAC, Micro-C) M0/M1/M2: target LSK_young LSK is HSPC not HSC; n=2; no raw counts so variance model is approximate
GSE132090 mouse LSK and MPP 0 independent replicates: one pool of two mice per genotype, two TECHNICAL library replicates bulk RNA-seq with ERCC EXCLUDED from inference no biological replication (stated in GEO overall design)
GSE285379 human HSPC and immune progeny from bone marrow 1 library per genotype x treatment (HSPC); donor-level replication not available from GEO 10x scRNA-seq EXCLUDED from inference one library per group: cells would be the only replicates, which is not allowed
GSE307624 human CD34+CD38-CD45RA- HSC 4 WT vs 7 mutant ATAC-seq not used (candidate M2d feature) epigenomic modality; no count matrix; same study as GSE287524
GSE65778 human HEK293T 2 per arm Ribo-seq + RNA-seq (paired) TRAIN (Tm) + specificity control (Tm+ISRIB) n=2; legacy annotation; tunicamycin acts through PERK plus other UPR branches
GSE254631 (+GSE254349 RNA) human U-2OS 2 per arm Ribo-seq + RNA-seq (paired series) TRAIN n=2; engineered line; arsenite is pleiotropic; stressed footprint libraries 0.6-0.8 M reads
GSE227766 human lung fibroblast: cycling, quiescent, IR- and etoposide-senescent RNA 2 vs 2; Ribo 3 vs 2 Ribo-seq + RNA-seq harvested in parallel TRAIN Tg libraries deposited 18 months after controls: batch confounded with treatment; no Tg arm for quiescent/senescent cells in GEO, so state-dependence of the ISR cannot be estimated from this series
GSE282509 human HeLa control and eIF2A-KO 3 control vs 2 treated Ribo-seq + total RNA TRAIN late time point: transcriptional adaptation and feedback included
GSE129757 human p53-deficient glioma line 3 per arm (Tm); 1 (Tg) Ribo-seq + RNA-seq TRAIN (Tm 2 h, 6 h); Tg excluded no publication linked; reference uORF targets show no TE response (weak or absent ISR); shared control for both time points
GSE193945 mouse SCC cells, eIF2a WT or S51A 3-4 per arm Ribo-seq + total RNA TRAIN (WT) + specificity control (S51A) proteasome inhibition is pleiotropic; GEO notes a corrected sample-label swap (Aug 2025); reference uORF targets flat in WT
GSE291029 human retinal pigment epithelial line 3 per arm Ribo-seq + VASA-seq total RNA TRAIN ISR is secondary to replication stress; late; weak reference response
GSE119365 mouse primary basophilic erythroblasts RNA 3-4, Ribo 2 per arm (pooled littermate fetal livers) Ribo-seq + mRNA-seq EXCLUDED from training by depth rule; descriptive only only hematopoietic and only HRI-specific set, but one WT footprint library has 0.14 M reads; chronic not acute
GSE256237 human HCT116 2 control, 4 stressed Ribo-seq + RNA-seq EXCLUDED from training by depth rule; descriptive only 3 of 4 stressed footprint libraries have <0.12 M assigned reads
GSE174764 human not checked 1 library per Tg dose Ribo-seq + RNA-seq not used dose series without replication
GSE248724/GSE248725 mouse mESC, eIF2a WT vs A/A knock-in 3 per arm Ribo-seq + RNA-seq not used (candidate) basal role of eIF2a-P, not a stress contrast
GSE268127 mouse mESC 3 vs 3 RNA-seq ONLY not used brief listed this as possible translation data: it is RNA-seq only
GSE273599 human U2OS 3 per arm RNA-seq ONLY not used in this run (late-phase transcription not modelled) transcriptome only; not HSPC

2. Identifiability: the 2x2 example

Gene A doubles in mRNA with TET2 loss; ISR doubles its TE in both genotypes. Linear output differs (I_S_linear = 10 units) while I_TE = 0 and gene-level log I_S = 0. The two-gene pathway shows a non-zero aggregate log interaction purely because the abundance weights differ.

unit dTE_WT dTE_TET2 I_TE dS_linear_WT dS_linear_TET2 I_S_linear I_S_log2
A 1.0000 1.0 0.0000 10.0 20.0 10.0 -0.0000
B -1.0000 -1.0 0.0000 -20.0 -20.0 0.0 0.0000
pathway{A,B} -0.3219 0.0 0.3219 -10.0 0.0 10.0 0.3219
